title: Share
description: x-share makes the element open the device's share sheet with shareTitle, shareText and shareUrl; where the Web Share API is missing it copies the URL to the clipboard instead.

text.description: Body text. Only used when `shareText` is absent.

shareTitle.description: Title passed to the share sheet. Read BEFORE `title`; falls back to `document.title`.

shareText.description: Body text passed to the share sheet. Read BEFORE `text`.

shareUrl.description: URL to share. Read BEFORE `url`; falls back to the current page address.

url.description: URL to share. Only used when `shareUrl` is absent.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
